workflow.title: Overdue invoice reminders and weekly summary
workflow.goal: Read the invoices sheet, keep only open invoices (disputed and paid are excluded), compute days overdue as of the run time, send a polite reminder at 30-59 days, a firmer one at 60-89 days, and a final notice at 90+ days, then email the user a summary of all open overdue invoices.

assumptions: The invoices sheet has one row per invoice with invoice, customer, email, amount, due (YYYY-MM-DD) and status (open | paid | disputed) columns.
The run is started once a week on Monday by an external scheduler, which supplies input.now; this workflow does not schedule itself.
Reminders go to the invoice email address; the summary goes to requester@example.test, which the user asked for.
Each outbound client message is approved by a person before it is sent.
risks: If the flow runs more often than the reminder stages change, a client can get the same tier reminder more than once; the flow keeps no send log.
Any invoice row with a missing email fails the audit pluck step.
Tone of the final notice is firm; the person should review the wording before approving sends.
successCriteria: Only open invoices are considered; disputed and paid invoices receive no reminder.
Invoices 30-59 days overdue receive the polite reminder, 60-89 the firm one, and 90+ the final notice.
The user receives one summary listing every open invoice past due.
The independent outbox audit passes for every message this run sent.

nodes.description: Read every row of the invoices sheet.
Keep only open invoices; disputed and paid are dropped.
Add daysOverdue (positive when the due date is in the past) relative to the run time.
Keep open invoices that are past due.
Invoices 30 to 59 days overdue.
Invoices 60 to 89 days overdue.
Invoices 90 or more days overdue.
Recipient addresses for the polite tier, for the audit.
Recipient addresses for the firm tier, for the audit.
Recipient addresses for the final tier, for the audit.
Send the polite reminder to each 30-59 day overdue client.
Fill the polite reminder text.

args.text:
Hello {{customer}},

This is a friendly reminder that invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}} was due on {{due}} and is now {{daysOverdue}} days past due. If you have already paid, please disregard this message. Otherwise, could you please arrange payment at your earliest convenience?

Thank you,
Accounts

nodes.description: Send the polite reminder to the client.
Send the firm reminder to each 60-89 day overdue client.
Fill the firm reminder text.

args.text:
Hello {{customer}},

Our records show that invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}} was due on {{due}} and is now {{daysOverdue}} days overdue. Please arrange payment promptly. If there is a problem with this invoice, please reply so we can resolve it.

Thank you,
Accounts

nodes.description: Send the firm reminder to the client.
Send the final notice to each 90+ day overdue client.
Fill the final notice text.

args.text:
Hello {{customer}},

FINAL NOTICE: invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}}, due on {{due}}, is now {{daysOverdue}} days overdue. Payment is required immediately. If we do not receive payment or hear from you within the next week, we will need to consider further steps to recover the amount.

Accounts

nodes.description: Send the final notice to the client.
One line per open overdue invoice.

args.empty: No open invoices are past due.

nodes.description: Fill the weekly summary text.
Email the weekly summary of who still owes to the user.
Independently re-read the outbox and confirm every message this run sent went to the expected recipients with matching hashes.
